Class ReflectiveAspectJAdvisorFactory

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.aop.aspectj.annotation.AbstractAspectJAdvisorFactory
org.springframework.aop.aspectj.annotation.ReflectiveAspectJAdvisorFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, AspectJAdvisorFactory
public class ReflectiveAspectJAdvisorFactory extends AbstractAspectJAdvisorFactory implements Serializable
能够根据符合 AspectJ 注解语法的类创建 Spring AOP Advisor 的工厂，它使用反射来调用相应的 Advice 方法。
Since:
2.0
Author:
Rod Johnson，Adrian Colyer，Juergen Hoeller，Ramnivas Laddad，Phillip Webb，Sam Brannen

      public @Nullable Advisor getAdvisor(Method candidateAdviceMethod, MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory aspectInstanceFactory, int declarationOrderInAspect, String aspectName)
      描述从接口复制：AspectJAdvisorFactory
      为给定的 AspectJ 建议方法构建一个 Spring AOP Advisor。

      `getAdvisor` 接口 `AspectJAdvisorFactory` 中
      Parameters:
      candidateAdviceMethod - 候选建议方法
      aspectInstanceFactory - 切面实例工厂

      aspectName - 切面的名称
